newsitem.title: USA: North America bunkers mostly lower amid supply.
newsitem.headline: North America bunkers mostly lower amid supply.

text.p: North American bunker prices were mostly lower in moderate trade this week amid a fall in NYMEX heating oil futures and a lack of demand, players said Tuesday.
On the Gulf Coast, Houston spot 380 CST, which dropped on Monday to the $80 a tonne range due to panic selling, was between $90 a tonne and $91 a tonne.
The range is $1 below last Thursday's levels.
Diesel was also down about $5 a tonne to $200, pressured by NYMEX heating oil futures which have suffered sharp losses on bearish weather.
